testimonials.name: Rajeshwar Verma
testimonials.quote: Harsh ji arranged our early morning Bhasma Aarti transfer to Ujjain flawlessly. Clean Innova Crysta, smooth highway drive, and courteous driver who guided our parents carefully at Mahakaleshwar.

testimonials.name: Dr. Ananya Trivedi
testimonials.quote: Took the Omkareshwar one-day trip in Dzire. The car was spotless, driver knew the Narmada ghat timings perfectly. Unbeatable pricing and very genuine service!

testimonials.name: Suresh & Sharda Patidar
testimonials.quote: Sanwariya Seth Darshan Yatra from Indore was comfortable beyond words. All tolls and parking were covered upfront as promised. Highly recommend Harsh Thakur's agency.

package_details.title: Omkareshwar & Mamleshwar Jyotirlinga Darshan
package_details.description: Sacred voyage to one of the 12 revered Jyotirlingas nestled along the sacred Narmada. Includes Mamleshwar darshan, Narmada sangam boat assistance, and comfortable round trip from Indore.

package_details.title: Ujjain Mahakal 5 Sacred Sites Darshan
package_details.description: Comprehensive spiritual darshan of Avantika Nagari covering 5 sacred sanctums: Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga, Harsiddhi Mata Shaktipeeth, Kal Bhairav, Maharishi Sandipani Ashram, and Mangalnath Temple.
highlights: Flexible pickup timing for Bhasma Aarti / Sawari

package_details.title: Shri Sanwariya Seth Darshan Yatra
package_details.description: Divine pilgrimage to the famous miracle-shrine of Lord Krishna (Sanwariya Seth) at Mandphiya. Long-distance comfort with toll taxes, state permits, and parking completely covered in Dzire.
